profile_text.body:
Synthesia is an AI video platform for business, founded in 2017 and headquartered in London. According to its own site, it lets users create studio-quality videos with AI avatars and voiceovers in 140+ languages, generate videos at scale from a single template, and set up live Sessions for roleplay practice and conversational surveys. The company says its platform is used to communicate, train, and upskill teams, and that it offers an API so its video technology can be built into other products. It describes a free Basic plan with 500 credits a month, enough for up to 10 minutes of video or 10 minutes of AI Dubbing.

The site lists a broad set of tools, including an AI Avatar Generator, AI Dubbing, PowerPoint to Video, Custom Avatars, a Free AI Video Generator, an AI Video Editor, an AI Voice Generator, AI Voice Cloning, AI Screen Recorder, AI Text to Video, Script to Video, an AI Script Generator, Video Translator, and Interactive Avatars. Synthesia describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business and says it is trusted by 90%+ of the Fortune 100. It states that it is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and ISO 42001 certified, and GDPR compliant, with EU data residency, and that enterprise teams get SSO and SCIM for access control. It also says every video goes through content moderation and that no one's likeness becomes an avatar without their explicit consent.

The site notes that some content is generated using artificial intelligence and labeled in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements. The company's product is tracked in the Video Generation & Editing category, with a note on AI avatars and likeness and consent risk. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
